name: Chipotle
cooks_in: Carnitas are cooked in their own fat. Rice bran oil is used for most items.
order_this: Carnitas bowl with guac and salsa.
skip_this: Skip anything else that uses rice bran oil. Avoid the vinaigrette.

name: Five Guys
cooks_in: Burgers are cooked on a clean flat-top with no oil. Fries are cooked in peanut oil.
order_this: Any burger lettuce-wrapped with no bun.
watch: Confirm toppings and sauces if strict.

name: Buffalo Wild Wings
cooks_in: Traditional wings are fried in beef tallow. Boneless wings use a different fryer.
